authentication.description: The token is an ephemeral capability scoped to one episode and one tool socket.

finalize-submission.effect: Validate and immutably seal the final submission; repeated sealing must be identical.

get-task.effect: Return the public task, database identity, budgets, and evaluation scope.

inspect-asset.effect: Resolve one returned asset ID to authoritative public metadata and bbox values.

search-assets.effect: Deterministically return at most the common Top-K bound from the frozen shared database.

validate-submission.effect: Validate the draft without exposing evaluator results or hidden labels.
